Aron

Steel Rock

Hoenn · Generation 3

Aron is a Steel/Rock-type Iron Armor Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 60 kg. It evolves into Lairon. Its highest base stat is Defense (100), with a base stat total of 330.
